relationships.subject: icariin
relationships.evidence_quote: Icariin activates the Nrf2/HO-1 cell signaling pathway to promote mitophagy, inhibit ferroptosis, maintain mitochondrial function, and enhance cell survival

relationships.subject: myricetin
relationships.evidence_quote: Myrcetin attenuates IVDD through its regulatory effects over the Nrf2/HO-1/NF-κB cell signaling pathway

relationships.subject: EGCG
relationships.evidence_quote: protects the IVD from H2O2-induced NP cell apoptosis and inflammation by inhibiting cGAS/Sting/NLRP3 activation

relationships.subject: naringin
relationships.evidence_quote: suppresses NLRP3 inflammasome activation [87] and IVDD [152]

relationships.subject: baicalein
relationships.evidence_quote: Baicalein reduces inflammatory cytokine expression by inhibiting the activation of NF-κB and p38 MAPK cell signaling [62].

key_findings: Review: plant flavonoids, terpenoids, polyphenols, pro-resolving lipids (LXA4, RvD1, maresins) and statins target signaling pathways in IVDD and low back pain
Several phytochemicals act via Nrf2/HO-1, NF-κB and NLRP3 pathways
